penalties_applied.name: requires_synchronous_human
penalties_applied.reason: Architectural consulting and implementation guidance for Salesforce Agentforce + Data Cloud almost certainly requires live discovery calls, Q&A sessions, and iterative back-and-forth with client teams — cannot be fully asynchronous.

penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Delivering a meaningful, client-specific reference architecture or implementation review requires human expert judgment per engagement; a generic guide has low value and won't command consulting rates.

penalties_applied.name: high_touch_support
penalties_applied.reason: Enterprise Salesforce buyers expect ongoing support, clarification, and iteration — this is not a one-and-done automated delivery.

rationale: The buyer is real — Salesforce architects and senior developers at licensed enterprises with active Agentforce budgets — and the pain is genuine and recurring as teams hit architectural dead-ends during implementation. However, this opportunity is fundamentally a consulting engagement: the value is in tailored, expert human judgment applied to a specific client's Salesforce org, Data Cloud configuration, and use case, which cannot be meaningfully automated by Claude. Operational autonomy scores 2 because every engagement requires per-customer human work, live calls, and iterative delivery. After penalties for human fulfillment, synchronous delivery, and support load, the total collapses to 1.7 — well below the validate threshold. A solo non-technical operator without deep Salesforce expertise cannot credibly sell or deliver this.
solution_plan: This is not buildable as an autonomous micro-service by a solo non-technical operator. The closest viable version — a Claude-generated decision-framework guide or reference architecture PDF sold as a digital product — would need to be generic enough to automate, but generic Salesforce architecture advice has minimal value to enterprise architects who need org-specific answers. A paid guide at $99-299 could be tested as a lead magnet, but it would not command consulting rates and would not solve the core problem. Realistically, this opportunity requires a Salesforce-certified consultant to deliver; the factory cannot substitute for that expertise. Recommend dropping unless the operator has direct Salesforce/Agentforce domain expertise and is willing to do consulting work personally.
notes: Fails operational_autonomy build_gate (score 2, floor 7) and buildability_with_ai build_gate (score 4, floor 6). Total after penalties (1.7) is far below min_total_to_validate (5.5). Drop.
